title: Statistics, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Built from the archived 2022-2023 bulletin (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2022-2023/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/statistics-bs/), fetched directly. Suggested Academic Plan course-by-semester sequence and prescribed-course list match the 2026 edition course-for-course (same Year 1-4 Fall/Spring placements as STAT-2023.json/STAT-2024.json). Same two real, verified differences as the 2023/2024 editions: (1) the 'Select 12 credits from the following' Advanced elective pool included 'RM 415 Modeling for Actuarial Science' and 'RM 420 Property, Casualty, and Health Insurance' (listed in this year's Program Requirements text as 'RM 415/420' alongside the other options 2026 still has) -- added both to this file's 4 shared-option-pool 'Advanced STAT/CMPSC elective' slots and RM to the departments list, same as STAT-2023.json/STAT-2024.json. (2) 'Select 9 credits from department-approved supporting courses' (not 8) -- modeled as 3 open_elective slots of 3 credits each (9 total) instead of 2026's 3+3+2 split, same as STAT-2023.json/STAT-2024.json. Entrance requirement text for this year explicitly states 'Minimum 2.0 GPA plus grades of C or better in MATH 140 and MATH 141' (not modeled as an entrance_to_major gate here since STAT-2026.json itself doesn't model one either -- no change from that precedent). Same MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 -> STAT 200/STAT 184 prereq-chain fix as STAT-2026.json applied here too, for the same reason given in STAT-2024.json's notes: Backend/catalogs/stat_catalog.json is a single file shared by every catalog-year plan, so the real literal MATH 21 prereq on STAT 200/184 applies here identically regardless of catalog_year.
